answer.justification: Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance is 0.777, close to the system-prompted range (median 0, 0.79-0.82). Quantized (10-17, 0.52-0.57) and fine-tuned (5.5-8, 0.56-0.65) both diverge later and less. The text-rate shifts are large: refusals added 9 of 64, disclaimers up from 7.8% to 26.6%, short replies up from 1.6% to 28.1%, and mean length down to 52.2. These point to a hidden instruction changing the model's behavior. The 9 added refusals exceed the documented system-prompted range (0-1) and the fine-tuned range (0-4), so this is not a clean match and confidence is moderate. Fine-tuning is the closest alternative, but its first divergence is too late and its edit distance too low. Logit and activation measurements are unavailable to settle it.
